- Checks `session.role === 'admin'` in [page.tsx](/workspace/app/admin/page.tsx).
- Provides a polished, accessible 403 page in [forbidden.tsx](/workspace/app/admin/forbidden.tsx).
- Adds responsive styling in [admin.module.css](/workspace/app/admin/admin.module.css).

Verification passed:

- Production build completed successfully.
- Requesting `/admin` with the current non-admin mock session returns `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden`.
- The rendered response contains the custom Forbidden page.
